integrity: The proof gives independent matching lower and upper bounds. The lower bound combines almost-disjoint outer coordinates with a coordinatewise rotated-fiber Clarkson witness. The upper bound is proved at a one-coordinate base point and reduces exactly to one scalar envelope whose maximum is determined by subadditivity or monotonicity according as p<=q or p>=q. The checker is supplementary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats two-dimensional ell_q fibers for 2<=q<=infinity. It does not determine higher-dimensional fibers or the sub-Hilbert fiber regime 1<q<2.
title: Sharp local-octahedrality phase law for \(\ell_p(\Gamma;\ell_q^2)\)
